court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
trial_court: Family Court at Pune, marriage petition No.694/2018
case_name: Smt. Swati Abhishek Naik (Old ... vs Shri. Abhishek Ramesh Naik

legal_principles.principle: The court may expedite the hearing of a petition in the interest of justice.
legal_principles.held: He submits that in the interest of justice, this court be pleased to expedite the hearing of petition filed by him.

legal_principles.principle: The court may not require detailed reasoning for an order if the parties agree.
legal_principles.held: Considering the submission made by learned advocate for applicant and as learned advocate for respondent has made a statement before this Court for allowing this application, it is not necessary to give detail reasoning for this order.

outcome.final_order: Marriage Peititon firled by respondent/husband u/s 13(1)(ia)(ib) of the Hindu Marriage Act before Family Court at Pune is transferred to Family Court at Nashik for hearing and final disposal on its own merits.
